identity.basis: Candidate is the same DSK Bank standalone symbol the accepted SVG represents; geometry identical to the official favicon.

assessment.independenceRationale: Official favicon asset, bank press release, and the OTP-group relationship (Wikipedia corroboration) are independent records.

variant.basis: Standalone symbol variant without text, published by the bank itself as favicon; colors per official source #50B848/#0F744A.

candidate.detailsJudgement: All emblem details preserved: open-ring gap, disc, satellite dot, internal transparency; no lost strokes or negative-space features
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Complete emblem fits the square cell with balanced clearances at 240px render; useful size and optical weight match the base; no clipping on either theme
candidate.rationale: Geometry-preserving color correction to the official source fills: the accepted icon reproduces the current DSK Bank mark with drifted colors (~59% of sampled pixels differ by >20 total RGB); the bank's own published favicon.svg is the authoritative standalone original vector.
candidate.role: Standalone bank symbol (ring + disc + dot), the bank's favicon variant, no accompanying text
transforms: Dropped the source's redundant svgjs outer svg wrapper, its no-op luminance mask (full-canvas white rect, unresolved reference #mask0_48_20664) and the no-op prefers-color-scheme style block; the three emblem paths are byte-identical (serialization-only normalization, verified pixel-identical at 240px).
No geometry change; no scale/translation needed (source viewBox 0 0 35 35 used as-is).

SVGO (installed CLI, frozen repo config svgo.config.mjs sha256-bound in optimize/svgo-receipt.json): 1043 -> 900 bytes, trial selected; working vs optimized renders differ only in 0 pixels above alpha-level noise (max channel diff 8, 0 pixels >8 at 240px).
candidate.variant: Current official standalone symbol with source fills #0F744A/#50B848; no circular-backing presentation observed or applied; transparent outside the emblem
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: Visible before/after color difference: inner disc and ring shift from the accepted file's drifted greens (#4fae2e/#016438) to the official source greens (#50B848/#0F744A); geometry and composition unchanged.

proposals.reason: The accepted SVG reproduces the current DSK Bank (OTP Group) standalone symbol with correct geometry, but its fill colors drift from the official source: inner disc #4fae2e vs official #50B848, ring #016438 vs official #0F744A; independent rendering shows ~59% of sampled pixels differing by >20 total RGB, a visible color shift. The official site serves the original vector favicon.svg, proposed as the color-corrected candidate.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Geometry-preserving color correction of the accepted icon to the official fills (#50B848/#0F744A) from the bank's own original vector; visible drift (~59% of sampled pixels differ by >20 RGB total) is confirmed by independent rasterization of both files.

sources.independenceGroup: official site favicon; press-kit page and 2017 rebrand announcement are separate official records
sources.observation: The official site serves favicon.svg: the standalone DSK symbol (light-green inner disc, dark-green open ring, top-right dot, no text) as an original published vector. Geometry matches the accepted SVG exactly; official fills are #50B848/#0F744A. Official press kit (media center) contains only mark+wordmark lockups (AI/CMYK), no standalone vector.

sources.independenceGroup: bank press release, independent of the favicon asset
sources.observation: Bank announcement of the OTP-aligned visual identity (2017) confirms the ring+disc+dot symbol is the bank's current brand mark, retained under the DSK name.
